role: Defines ModelOptionRow, one selectable model row in the Flo tab's Choose model sheet (used by CoachHomeV2View.providerModels, CoachHomeV2View.swift:471). The file name ModelPicker does not match its only type.
types: ModelOptionRow: struct — SwiftUI button row selecting a ModelOption in ProviderRegistry

units.does: True when registry.activeModel.id ('providerRawValue:apiID') equals this row's model.id.

Plain-style Button whose action calls registry.setActive(model:): if the model's providerID matches a provider in allProviders it sets activeProvider/activeModel, persists them to UserDefaults and refreshes the availability cache (otherwise a silent no-op, ProviderRegistry.swift:208); adds the .isSelected accessibility trait when selected. This row is the only caller of setActive(model:) in the app, i.e. the only UI that switches provider/model.
units.entry: SwiftUI body; button tap by user in the Choose model sheet.

branches.effect: adds .isSelected accessibility trait; otherwise adds no trait

units.does: HStack with model.displayName (15pt semibold scaled), the catalog blurb looked up as LocalizedStringKey in the app bundle (12pt), a spacer and selectedMark; whole row is the tap shape.
Checkmark circle in AppTheme.wongOptimal (accessibility-hidden) when selected.

branches.effect: shows the checkmark; renders nothing otherwise
